svg.title: What an agent can reach: on the host versus in the agent box
svg.desc: Every path an agent can read or write. The host agent (grey) reaches all of them. The agent in the box: Your project (the workspace): read-write, same path; The coding repo, when you work elsewhere: read-only; Session transcripts: read-write → session logs; Agent settings and logins: its own, not yours; The rest of your home folder: not visible; The guard: hooks, rules, hook settings: root-owned, read-only; Guard keys and audit log: public key only; Docker socket: no socket; coding containers: via coding svc; Host processes and daemons: not visible; Knowledge injection: not loaded; LLM proxy :12435: every model call; Guard daemon :3035: can ask, never approve; Health coordinator :3034: GET /health/state only; Graphify MCP :3851: read tools, default graph; Host web UIs :3032 :3033 :12436: look, never change; Other host services: refused at the gate; A browser in the box: Chromium, Playwright, mkdocs; Internet: login hosts only; Your terminal: keys, screen, paste; Overriding a rule: only grants you sign; git push / fetch, gh: via the guard.
svg.text: F I L E S A N D F O L D E R S
C O N T A I N E R S A N D P R O C E S S E S
N E T W O R K
Y O U A N D Y O U R A C C O U N T S
Grey: an agent on the host reaches everything you can. Colour: what the same agent reaches from inside the agent box.
Linux container · your uid, not root
what you launched in; the agent works here in both cases
The coding repo, when you work elsewhere
tools, plugins and extensions the agent runs
host: ~/.claude, ~/.copilot, Keychain · box: own login in a volume; pi gets a copy
The rest of your home folder
other repos, ~/.ssh, cloud credentials, ~/.coding data, shell config
The guard: hooks, rules, hook settings
on the host the agent can edit them, or switch its hooks off
~/.coding/guard: signing key, approver token, hash-chained audit
host: start, stop, rebuild any container, mount any folder
box: status, logs, restart, graphify; up / rebuild need your approval
host: kill, launchctl / systemctl, restart services
loaded for the host agent only
routed, metered and logged; from the box through the network gate
override requests and coding svc; approving needs your factor
the health line on each prompt; every other route refused at the gate
the coding code graph; other tools and other projects refused at the gate
dashboard, its API, knowledge viewer: GET only; writes, WebSocket, cookies refused
Qdrant :6333, Redis, the containers' own ports …
screenshots of pages served in the box, the docs it builds, the UIs above
e.g. platform.claude.com for claude; every refusal is reported
tmux pane; Cmd+V image paste goes through a bridge
host: one line in the transcript, which the agent can type itself
pinned remotes only, no force or delete; gh reads free, PR writes need you
Levels: --no-box (grey, on the host) · --box, the default (all colours) · --strict-box (no dashed light-blue rows: those UIs show every repo).
Box network: an internal Docker network; its gate forwards the LLM proxy and the guard and relays the listed reads. CODING_BOX_NETWORK=open lifts it (recorded).
Default: every agent (claude, copilot, opencode, pi) runs in the box. --no-box is recorded in the guard audit log. Planned (Phase 3): result-check state out of the agent’s reach.
